articles.summary: Team completes Bradley-to-Fountain segment ahead of schedule, as part of the Midway-to-Kelker progressive design-build program Construction is off to a successful start in Colorado Springs, Colo., as Great Southwestern Construction (Great Southwestern), an MYR Group subsidiary, completed the first transmission line segment of a portfolio of electrical transmission and substation projects for Colorado Springs Utilities […]
articles.title: Great Southwestern Construction Achieves Early Completion of First Segment of 230kV Transmission Project Portfolio

articles.summary: Alaska’s Glenn Highway is a critical transportation corridor, connecting Anchorage to more rural parts of the state making it a heavily trafficked highway used by residents and visitors. Sturgeon Electric Company (Sturgeon Electric), an MYR Group subsidiary, earned a 2026 Project Excellence Award from the National Electrical Contractors Association (NECA) for its work on this unique streetlighting project along the Glenn Highway.
articles.title: Sturgeon Electric Earns 2026 NECA Project Excellence Award for Streetlighting
